'''Pucumir Thryss''' was a secret contact for the [[Alliance Army/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] on the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], up until the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Occupation of Bespin|occupation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|world]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] then came to the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] where, in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], he visited the [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] of [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. While in the palace's throne room, Thryss watched and cheered while the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] battled Jabba's [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] and eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]] it.

==Biography==
[[File:JabbaChewie.jpg|thumb|right|350px|Pucumir Thryss (between [[Rayc Ryjerd]] and [[Rennek]]) stood in the palace throne room while Jabba negotiated with Leia Organa.]]
Pucumir Thryss was a [[Miner/Legends|miner]] of [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] on<ref name="Who's Who" /> the floating [[City/Legends|city]]<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]],<ref name="Who's Who" /> located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="CL" /> One of<ref name="CCG" /> the secret contacts for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] there, he was forced off Bespin when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Who's Who" /> occupied the [[Planet/Legends|world]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Bespin">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Occupation of Bespin]] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> Afterwards, Thryss came to<ref name="Who's Who" /> the Outer Rim planet<ref name="CL" /> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], still longing to return to<ref name="Who's Who" /> and retake<ref name="CCG" /> Cloud City from the Imperials through serious firepower.<ref name="Who's Who" />

One [[Local day/Legends|day]]<ref name="JN">[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]]</ref> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="4 ABY">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}} to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> Thryss was present in<ref name="ROTJ" /> the Tatooine [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="CL" /> While he spent [[Time/Legends|time]] in the Jabba's throne room behind<ref name="ROTJ" /> the Hutt's roasting spit,<ref name="CL" /> the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] performed the song "[[Jedi Rocks/Legends|Jedi Rocks]]." During the performance,<ref name="ROTJ" /> Jabba's [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] dancer<ref name="Who's Who" /> [[Oola/Legends|Oola]] rejected his advances and was sent into the pit of Jabba's pet [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|rancor]], where<ref name="ROTJ" /> she<ref name="Who's Who" /> was eaten alive by it. Moments later, [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] member [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], disguised as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]], arrived at to the throne room with her ally [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], who acted as her catch. Thryss remained behind the spit while Jabba and Organa negotiated over the price of Chewbacca. After a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] scare from Organa, the two settled on a price of 35,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Who's Who" /> The throne room party started up again afterwards.<ref name="JN" />

The next morning,<ref name="JN" /> the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] arrived at the palace to free his friend, the Rebel [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], from Jabba. Having failed his negotiation, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was soon sent into the pit of the rancor. Thryss, from the palace throne room, cheered and thrusted his fists through the air while spectating Skywalker<ref name="ROTJ" /> and [[Jubnuk/Legends|Jubnuk]], a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guard<ref name="Jubnuk">{{CSWECite|II|177|Jubnuk}}</ref> accidentally sent with the Jedi. Jubnuk was quickly eaten by the rancor, though Skywalker, using a large gate, [[Death/Legends|killed]] the creature, much to the shock of Thryss. He later watched [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], a friend of Skywalker's posing as a guard, push though the spectator crowd to retrieve Skywalker and his friends. Not long afterwards, Jabba sentenced the Jedi, Solo, and Chewbacca, to death at Tatooine's [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Thryss was a [[Color/Legends|black]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] and dark-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]] who sported a diagonal scar across his face.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Though his longing to return to and retake Cloud City from Imperial occupation appeared noble, he presented himself as enjoying bloodsport,<ref name="Who's Who" /> cheering while Luke Skywalker fought Jabba's rancor.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Equipment==
While at Jabba's Palace, Thryss wore a beige [[Cape/Legends|cape]] and a white [[Clothing/Legends|dress]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|In the widescreen edition of Jedi, watch Thryss pump his fists like a soccer fan as Luke is menaced by the rancor.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Who's Who" />}}
Pucumir Thryss first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] movie [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ" /> The Jabba's Palace scenes featuring the character, who was portrayed by an uncredited extra, were filmed between [[January 25]] and [[February 8]], [[1982]] on Stage 8 at [[Elstree Studios]].<ref name="Making of">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> Thryss was first identified in the [[1998]] ''[[Jabba's Palace Limited]]'' set of [[Decipher|Decipher's]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG" /> In the article "[[Who's Who in Jabba's Palace]]," published in the [[Star Wars Insider 60|sixtieth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Who's Who" /> on [[June 4]], [[2002]],<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20020510.html|text=Post-''Clones'' Fan Magazines}}</ref> author [[Daniel Wallace]] likens the way Thryss thrusts his fists through the air to that of a [[Wikipedia:Association football|soccer]] fan.<ref name="Who's Who" />
